details.completeness_justification: Only four of the ten key criteria are fully or partially covered. The headline Q2 financial performance (K1) and impairment charges (K8) are adequately represented, while deposit dynamics (K2), subsidiary results (K3), strategic developments (K4), capital/liquidity ratios (K5), operating environment (K6), first-half results (K7), and managed funds (K9) are either missing or only partially addressed. The overall picture of performance and strategy is therefore incomplete.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. All statements follow a logical progression from profitability metrics to income components, expenses, balance-sheet items, and strategic developments. No sentence contradicts another, and related information is grouped consistently without unnecessary repetition.
